hostName.description: The host of the domain you would like to have for you trunk.

topLevelDomain.description: The top level domain to which the SIP trunk belongs.

domain.description: The fully qualified name of the domain, which is a combination of your 'hostName' and the 'topLevelDomain'.

name.description: The friendly name of your SIP trunk.

callsPerSecond.description: Number of calls started per second, to increase this please contact your account manager.

enableCallerName.description: Enable caller name lookup for incoming calls. US and canada only.

callForwardNumber.description: The valid E.164 phone number that will be dialed on inbound calls when no SIP endpoints are available. Required if `enableCallForward` property is `true`.

enableCallForward.description:
When enabled, if an inbound call can not be delivered to a SIP endpoint, calls will be forwarded to the configured `callForwardNumber`. To forward all calls without trying SIP, simply disable (or delete) all SIP endpoints on this trunk. Logs (and billing) will be created for 2 calls (inbound and outbound). 
**Note:** Since there is no SIP connection, PCAPs will not be generated.

createTime.description: The date and time that the SIP trunk was created.

updateTime.description: The date and time that the SIP trunk was last modified.
